title: To a Fly, Your Swat Looks Like Slow Motion

scenes.text: To a fly, your swat looks like slow motion.
You see about sixty flashes of light per second.
Some flies see two hundred fifty.
To a fly, a movie at twenty-four frames per second looks like a slideshow.
Your hand comes in slow, so it just hops away.
One predatory fly sees time about six times slower than you.

description:
To a fly, your swat looks like slow motion.
Humans resolve about 60 flashes per second, while some flies see up to 250, so your hand seems to move slowly.
Have you ever actually caught one?
first_comment: Bonus: a predatory killer fly may see time about six times slower than we do. Ever caught a fly by hand?
